description: Ministry of Highways - Amended Gaz. Extraordinary No. 2163/33 of 20.02.2020, Regulations under Section 89 under National Thoroughfares Act. No. 40 of 2008
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Highways under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008, specifically amending the National Thoroughfares (User Fee) Regulations. This constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory amendments, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions a minister by name, it does not involve government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather focuses on establishing legal frameworks and regulatory requirements for highway user fees.
